intent.goal: Stop prove-it id-4 and oncall-it id-4 failing a doctrine-following workspace whose .venv holds third-party code that matches their **/*.py bans, without blunting the bans on the case's own tree.
intent.ruled_out: Excluding .venv/ by name (a venv of any other name, or site-packages elsewhere, would still trip the ban); an oracle-level ignore list (the oracle engine is out of scope and would change every case); narrowing the regexes (they would stop catching real violations); a fabricated third-party excerpt for oncall-it's label ban (nothing installed hits it, so its venv proof is the PII ban's).
intent.why: deflake-it and harden-it already scope the same class of ban to tests/**, the case's code dir and root *.py, so reading only the case tree is the pattern the reviewers accepted. Committed verbatim excerpts, each required to hit every scoped copy, keep the venv proof honest, and one violating row per copy keeps each copy's teeth.
